meta.title: A signed-in user who gets blocked is signed out on the next request with the same message
precondition: QA-USER signed in on the device
steps: Block the user on the local DB (reason harassment)
Cold start the app (next request) and wait up to 20 s
expected: The blocked message 'Your account is blocked' with 'Reason: Harassment or hate' (auth.blocked) appears — UI tree + screenshot
The user is signed out: the Profile tab shows the guest Profile — UI tree

done: 1. Block the user on the local DB

1.observed: blocked card=True, texts=['Your account is blocked', 'Reason: Harassment or hate']
